findings.title: All 12 success criteria are covered by tasks with no gaps or scope creep
findings.description:
Cross-reference of success criteria against tasks:

- **SC1** (flow selection: `concept`/no-arg/`comprehension`/else) → Task 1 (selector authoring), Task 8.5 (live selection test)
- **SC2** (only two fixed questions + single confirmation, extraction precedes interaction) → Task 5 (interview + confirmation), Task 8.1 (happy path check), Task 8.2 (decline path)
- **SC3** (prose cites file, structural names graph field, Dev Approach from filesystem) → Task 3 (three-source extraction), Task 4 (per-section mapping), Task 8.1
- **SC4** (dropped topics nowhere) → Task 4.1 (dropped-topics rule stated), Task 8.1
- **SC5** (declined question → gap marker + provenance entry) → Task 5.1, Task 8.2
- **SC6** (User-Provided Concept verbatim, pre-existing survives) → Task 6, Task 8.4
- **SC7** (guide absent → loud stop) → Task 6.1, Task 8.3
- **SC8** (existing concept never overwritten, default stop) → Task 6.2, Task 8.4
- **SC9** (frontmatter valid, filename uses cf project name) → Task 7.2, Task 8.1
- **SC10** (provenance carries full outcome set) → Task 7.3, Task 8.1
- **SC11** (whole graph never loaded, no function/class node read) → Task 3.1 (discipline statement), Task 8.6
- **SC12** (PM would edit rather than discard) → Task 8.1 (happy path against squadron)

findings.title: Task sequencing respects dependencies with no circular references
findings.description: Task 0 (branch/premise) → Task 1 (selector) → Task 2 (preconditions) → Task 3 (sources) → Task 4 (mapping) → Task 5 (interview) → Task 6 (contract) → Task 7 (governance/output) → Task 8 (verification walkthrough) → Task 9 (close). Each task builds on prior outputs; no task depends on a later one.

findings.title: Commit markers are placed correctly at tested points
findings.description: `Commit:` markers (plain lines) appear at the end of Tasks 1.2, 2.2, 3.4, 4.2, 5.3, 6.3, 7.4, and 8.6 — all points where work has been verified, not after every subtask and not only at the end. A file with no markers is acceptable; these are correctly scoped.

findings.title: Task 8 verification walkthrough is appropriately sized for the slice complexity
findings.description: Task 8 has 6 subtasks covering happy path (8.1), decline path (8.2), contract failure (8.3), re-run (8.4), flow selection (8.5), and discipline/scope (8.6). Each maps to specific success criteria. The 3/5 effort on 8.1 is justified as the integration verification point exercising the correction outcome. No subtask is too large to be independently completable.

findings.title: Proportionality — task count, detail, and file scope fit the slice
findings.description: The slice edits one skill file (`commands/analysis/understand.md`) and generates one concept document. Nine tasks with ~30 subtasks, including thorough verification, matches the complexity. especially given the design's emphasis on verbatim wording, loud-failure contracts, and provenance completeness.

findings.title: No load test required — slice has no NFRs
findings.description: The slice design contains no non-functional requirements or performance constraints. It is a markdown-editing slice; no `tests/load/` task is needed. and none is missing.
